name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:

concurrency:
  group: compile-time-tracker-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    name: Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.10
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt', 'dev-requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r dev-requirements.txt
          pip install -e .

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          python setup.py build

  test:
    name: Test (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    strategy:
      matrix:
        platform: [single-card, t3k, galaxy]
    timeout-minutes: 60
    env:
      PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.10
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt', 'dev-requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install -r dev-requirements.txt
          pip install -e .

      - name: Run mandatory model tests
        run: |
          pytest -m "models-mandatory" --maxfail=1
        continue-on-error: false

      - name: Run extended model tests
        run: |
          pytest -m "models-extended" --maxfail=1
        continue-on-error: false
